Cecelia.report: Best touch on the team with elite game-reading ability. Set piece specialist.
Cecelia.strengths: 5.0 interceptions/60 (2nd on team), strong tackles (5.5/60). Best passing quality and touch. Designated corner/set piece taker — dangerous delivery.
Cecelia.develop: Lacks explosive speed — work on positioning to compensate. Could be more vocal in organizing the midfield. Getting more involved in build-up play.

Celeste.report: High-energy midback with a nose for goal. Limited minutes due to goalie rotation, not stamina.
Celeste.strengths: Best goals-per-60 on team (2 in 193 min). 13.1 duels/60, 26 sprints. Plays with intensity that lifts the whole team.
Celeste.develop: Defensive positioning when caught upfield — sometimes gets too far forward and leaves gaps. Communication with backline during transitions.

Deanna.report: Tireless forward who does the dirty work — pressing, recovering, disrupting.
Deanna.strengths: 5.6 tackles/60, 11.1 duels/60, most loose ball recoveries (9). Wins the ball back high up the pitch constantly.
Deanna.develop: Zero goals despite good minutes — needs to develop finishing and shooting confidence. Could benefit from positioning drills to get into scoring spots rather than always chasing the ball.

Donna Ann.report: Most technically gifted on the ball — dribbles past pressure and picks out passes.
Donna Ann.strengths: Highest dribble rate (2.8/60), best pass accuracy among starters (38%), 4.6 interceptions/60. Clinical finisher (2 goals from 6 games).
Donna Ann.develop: Stamina limits minutes — work on fitness to extend playing time. Could be more assertive in demanding the ball in tight games.

Josie.report: Complete forward who does everything at an elite level. First name on the teamsheet.
Josie.strengths: Highest tackles/60 (6.7), fastest player (33.2 kph), best pass accuracy (47%), most sprints. Presses from the front, wins the ball high, finishes chances.
Josie.develop: Already the most well-rounded player. Could work on creating more shooting opportunities — high work rate sometimes takes her away from goal-scoring positions.

Katelyn.report: Incredibly tenacious and fast — chases everything but still developing her technique.
Katelyn.strengths: Most tenacious player on the roster. Fast and agile. 2 goals from 4 games — best conversion rate. Creates chances through pure effort and speed.
Katelyn.develop: All ball skills need work — dribbling, passing, shooting are very raw. Has great opportunities she can't finish yet. Coaching challenge: channel the energy without suppressing what makes her special.

Kendall.report: Most durable defender on the team — plugs in anywhere and holds it down.
Kendall.strengths: Most minutes (333), 5.8 tackles/60, 43% pass accuracy. Consistent, rarely beaten. Gets forward on set pieces (1 goal, 4 shots).
Kendall.develop: Could work on speed/acceleration to recover when beaten. Positioning awareness in 1v1 situations against faster attackers.

Millie.report: Aggressive midback who competes hard and gets forward into shooting positions.
Millie.strengths: 10.9 duels/60, 8 shots from midfield. High energy, never gives up on a ball. Gets box-to-box naturally.
Millie.develop: Pass accuracy (29%) is the lowest on team — the biggest area to improve. Work on simple, safe passes rather than forcing difficult ones. First touch under pressure.

Quinn.report: Explosive intensity in short bursts — terrorizes opponents when she comes on.
Quinn.strengths: 20.2 duels/60 and 7.3 tackles/60 — nobody comes close. Wins every ball in her area. Maximum effort every minute she plays.
Quinn.develop: Stamina limits her to shorter stints. Work on pacing energy across longer stretches. Passing and first touch under pressure could improve to complement her ball-winning.

Sage.report: Aggressive wing/forward who presses hard and gets into shooting positions.
Sage.strengths: Leads team in total duels (89), 16.7 duels/60. One of the fastest (33.6 kph). 11 shots — gets into dangerous areas.
Sage.develop: Pass accuracy (32%) — when she wins the ball she sometimes gives it right back. Working on composure after winning possession and making the right pass.

Sienna.report: The heartbeat of the backline — elite at reading the game and intercepting, but needs to slow down with the ball.
Sienna.strengths: Leads team in interceptions (4.3/60) — reads opposing passes at an elite level and uses her quickness to win the ball. Highest passing volume on the team (10.1/60), constantly involved in play. Fast and agile in defensive situations.
Sienna.develop: Only 1 dribble on the entire season tells the story — after winning the ball she immediately looks to get rid of it rather than taking a moment with it. The high pass volume with low accuracy (28%) reflects this urgency. She needs to work on: holding the ball for a beat after winning it to find a proper passing option, attempting even basic dribbles to create space and open up mid-range lanes, and finding composed passes to midbacks rather than hopeful long balls downfield. If she can get her pass accuracy up even 10-15%, she becomes arguably the most valuable player on the team — the game-reading and interception ability is already elite, and adding composure on the ball would anchor the entire defensive unit and unlock the team's build-up play.

Tessa.report: Complete midback who reads the game and distributes forward.
Tessa.strengths: 6.6 tackles/60, 12.5 duels/60, 4.8 interceptions/60. Solid passing (37% accuracy, 9.8/60). Shields the defense intelligently.
Tessa.develop: Could push forward more in attacking phases. Adding more shots and goal threat from midfield would make her harder to play against.

Westerly.report: Composed defender who keeps the ball moving and reads passing lanes.
Westerly.strengths: 9.9 successful passes/60 (2nd on team), 3.2 interceptions/60. Fast (32.2 kph). Positional and intelligent rather than reckless.
Westerly.develop: Could be more aggressive in 1v1 duels — lower tackle/duel numbers suggest she avoids contact. Adding physicality to her game while keeping composure.

Willow.report: Two-way wing who never stops running — covers more ground than almost anyone.
Willow.strengths: 6.5 tackles/60, 12.9 duels/60, 10 shots + 1 goal. 22.2 km over the season. Competes on both sides of the ball.
Willow.develop: Crossing and final ball delivery from wide areas. Could improve end product — lots of effort getting into positions but needs cleaner execution in the final third.
